Because most HTMX attributes, not all of

Setting when they're using other HTMX

And this inheritance concept is an important
concept and you can always find out whether
an attribute supports inheritance or not by
taking a look at the documentation of that
attribute. And if you then scroll down all
the way to the bottom, you will find these
notes and there you learn that the element
is inherited or whether it's not inherited.
For example, all those attributes that
trigger requests are not inherited,
which kind of makes sense because you don't
wanna start sending the same kind of request
for all the child elements of some element.
hx-swap is inherited though, and therefore
by setting it on the unordered list, instead
of the buttons inside of the list, we can
now make sure that if we reload
and we again add some items here,
we got the same behavior as before.
The items are removed here, but we now made
